situation: Start at the board address #/ with the default data and let the clock run 2200 ms, so that every column has loaded.
Select SL-106, SL-107 and SL-108 with the x key (focus SL-106, x, ArrowDown, x, ArrowDown, x).
Click the button "Review" in the "Move selected to" group, then let the clock run 400 ms. The service fails the move of SL-107.
question: What does the notice say, what is selected, and what is the order of Backlog and Review?
answer: Notice: "Moved 2 of 3 cards to Review. Couldn't move SL-107." with Retry and Dismiss. Only SL-107 is selected ("1 selected"). Review: SL-106, SL-108. Backlog: SL-101 to SL-105, SL-109, SL-107, SL-110 (SL-107 goes back to its old index).

checks.announced: Moved 2 of 3 cards to Review. Couldn't move SL-107.
